verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own API credential mechanism, an OAuth setup for the Drata API (drata-docs-6), and positions the API and an official MCP server for AI agents (drata-docs-2, drata-probe-4). However, nothing in the evidence shows these credentials can be scoped to specific resources or read/write permissions. The drata-agent's 'READ ONLY' wording describes OS-level device permissions, not API credentials, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or least-privilege permission granularity for API keys, agent-specific credential issuance, credential lifecycle (rotation/revocation/expiry), and independent corroboration.
